verdict.rationale: The provider's own products page mentions an attorney in its workflow ("nothing slips between candidate, manager, and attorney"), which implies lawyer involvement in cases. It does not name any lawyers, state licensure, or say who is attorney of record and files the petition. The remaining evidence covers narrative-building, evidence packaging, and support, without saying who prepares or signs filings. Missing for 10: named licensed attorneys, a stated attorney-of-record model, an explicit statement that attorneys prepare and file petitions, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service

citations.quote: We plug into your People Ops so nothing slips between candidate, manager, and attorney.
